xsecsim e-HF cross-section set (0-100 eV), format 'species', generated by scripts/build_lxcat.py
Method summary: docs/M2_report.md, docs/M3_report.md, docs/M4_report.md (nonlocal resonance model);
comparison with Itikawa (2017) in docs/figures/.
Convention for the rotational cross sections: mt (mt = momentum transfer, recommended; ics = integral;
aniso = integral with the momentum-transfer cross section in column 3, for boltzpmp >= 0.2 anisotropic scattering).
Note: the dipole rotational excitation of HF is strongly forward peaked; with isotropic scattering 'ics'
overestimates momentum transfer and 'mt' underestimates the rotational energy loss (see docs/M3_report.md).
Units: energy eV, cross section m^2. No data above 100 eV (solvers extrapolate the last value).
